journalEntries.title: Quest Objective
journalEntries.textSummary: Retrieve Merlin's Tetrahedronal hidden within the Ruins of the Dark Galan. Begin with Prism Fragment A.

journalEntries.title: Fog of Confusion
journalEntries.textSummary: Fog of Confusion is super effective against the Imp.

journalEntries.title: Pulse of Calm
journalEntries.textSummary: Pulse of Calm is super effective against the Musca.

journalEntries.title: Heart Beacon
journalEntries.textSummary: Heart Beacon is super effective against the Lizardman.

journalEntries.title: Prophecy of the Armour of Light
journalEntries.textSummary: A champion shall don the Armour of Light, with the Tetrahedronal beside them as a key to dispelling darkness.

journalEntries.title: Cure All Stats Potion
journalEntries.textSummary: The Cure All Stats Potion restores full strength and cleanses corruption.

journalEntries.title: Camelot Party Roles
journalEntries.textSummary: In old Camelot roles, Galans healed, Knights bore the shield, and Makidons or Mages dealt damage.

journalEntries.title: Galania and Xerces
journalEntries.textSummary: Galania was betrayed by Xerces, who aligned with darkness and the Cult of Asherah.

journalEntries.title: The Ruin Remembers
journalEntries.textSummary: Fleeing a fight exacts a toll upon body and spirit.

journalEntries.title: Final Prism Fragment
journalEntries.textSummary: The third and final Prism Fragment has been recovered. Assembly is now possible.

journalEntries.title: Prism of Makidos
journalEntries.textSummary: The Prism of Makidos is whole and can dissolve the Galanic Seal.

journalEntries.title: Final Chamber
journalEntries.textSummary: The final chamber is open; beyond it lies the soul of the ruin and the final battle.

journalEntries.title: Hero of the Prophecy
journalEntries.textSummary: Hero who overcame the Voices of Care and awakened the Prophecy of the Stone.
